q: When did the law on home rule in Greenland come into force?
appeared: It appeared in the November 2020 and June 2021 exams.

da.q: Hvornår trådte loven om hjemmestyre i Grønland i kraft?

learn.text: After a referendum, Greenland got home rule by law in 1979, which meant that Greenland gradually in the following years took over responsibility for, and the possibility of passing its own laws in, a number of areas, for example social policy, taxes and duties, and education.

q: Are Greenland and the Faroe Islands part of the EU?
appeared: It appeared in the November 2022 and May 2025 exams.

da.q: Er Grønland og Færøerne en del af EU?

learn.text: Today neither Greenland nor the Faroe Islands is part of the EU, although Denmark is.

q: Which symbol is part of Greenland's flag?
appeared: It appeared in the May 2024 and November 2025 exams.

da.q: Hvilket symbol indgår i Grønlands flag?

learn.text: The circle in the flag symbolises the rising sun in the white Greenlandic landscape. The flag is widely used in Greenland.
